svg.aria-label: BHUMI-NITI — 2,457 real land-record plot outlines of Vadnerbhairav drawn and coloured by the gap between map and record

g.text: Every plot of land has two stories.
One is written down. One is on the ground.
2,457 real BhuNaksha plot outlines · Vadnerbhairav, Nashik · coloured by map-vs-7/12 gap
